name: sim_caretaker_takes_a_seat_mid_match
description: The caretaker takes a seat mid-match where the player's towers already stand (design 6.7, M4 track C). The Lamplighter built a cannon on her plan's first arrow cell and an arrow on its second, then goes AWAY at wave 3 beside a caretaken Lookout. The caretaker starts at her plan's beginning: it counts those two build steps done instead of building the arrows again on the alternative cells a second Lamplighter would take, never forks her cannon as if it were the plan's arrow, forks her arrow where the plan says, builds the rest with her own gold, never sells, and her towers keep firing. Before M4 it built two more arrows on 7,11 and 11,12 and forked the cannon.

steps.assert: scene.tower_at(8, 11).kind == 'cannon' and scene.tower_at(11, 11).kind == 'arrow' and scene.tower_at(8, 11).owner == 1 and scene.tower_at(11, 11).owner == 1
steps.msg: the player stands a cannon on the plan's first arrow cell and an arrow on its second
the player never left: the seat's plan cursor is at the start
AWAY hands the seat to the caretaker
the caretaker worked past the plan's forks of both cells
it built no second arrow for steps the player had done, on the cells a second Lamplighter would take
it did not fork the player's cannon where the plan forks an arrow
it forked the player's arrow where the plan says
it built the rest of the plan, each build paid from the seat's own gold
